sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/glaciercampground (Campspot park 1879: availability with prices for 1 night, 2 adults, 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-14; none offered 2026-10-27)

values.note: Campspot, 1 night for 2 adults on 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-14 (same prices): 20 Amp/Water RV (to 26 ft) $68.25, 30 Amp/Water Small RV (to 22 ft) $73.25, Medium (to 28 ft) $78.25, Large (to 32 ft) $88.25; tent/van-car sites $53.25-63.25, cabins $98.25-108.25. Plus 8% bed tax and a 3% credit-card fee; extra guests 5+ $5/night.

fees.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/glaciercampground (averagePricePerNight per site category for 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-14) + https://www.glaciercampground.com/glacier-campground-accommodations-tent-cabin-rv-trailers-rooftop-tents/ ('* + 8% Bed Tax & 3% Credit Card Fee', 'additional guests that are 5 years old and older are an additional $5/per person/per night'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.glaciercampground.com/glacier-campground-accommodations-tent-cabin-rv-trailers-rooftop-tents/ ('20 Amp/Water Small RV (up to 26′) | 30 Amp/Water Small RV (up to 22′) | 30 Amp/Water Medium RV (up to 28′) | 30 Amp/Water Large RV (up to 32′)'; 'we do NOT have full hook-ups for RV sites (water and electric ONLY)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 74 RV sites on Campspot (11 20-amp to 26 ft, 10 30-amp small to 22 ft, 25 medium to 28 ft, 28 large at 32 ft), plus 66 tent or van/car sites with 20-amp electric and 10 rustic cabins. '32′ max length for RVs and travel trailers (this does NOT include your tow vehicle)'. The 30-amp categories include pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.glaciercampground.com/glacier-campground-accommodations-tent-cabin-rv-trailers-rooftop-tents/ + https://www.campspot.com/book/glaciercampground (campsites per category with rvLengthMax; category amenities 'Pull-Through'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Two bathhouses with hot/cold water and flush toilets, open 24/7 in season, guests only. Coin laundry (closed 11am-2pm). Dump station free to RV guests ($15 per dump for tent sites); pumper truck $25 with 24 hours' notice. Office sells firewood, ice and limited supplies; propane refills. Wi-Fi only at the office patio and cafe, not at sites. No generators at any time; EV charging not allowed.

facilities.source: https://www.glaciercampground.com/glacier-campground-accommodations-tent-cabin-rv-trailers-rooftop-tents/ (BATHHOUSES & LAUNDRY, OFFICE, WIFI, PROPANE, EV CHARGING, 'No operation of generators at any time', dump station text), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Full payment at booking for stays of 5 nights or less (50% for 6+); cancellations 15+ days out (31+ for 6+ nights) refunded less $75 per site. Check-in and check-out 11 am (cabins 2 pm in).
10% for military, retired military, police and firefighters on RV/trailer/tent sites (ID on arrival).

discounts.source: https://www.glaciercampground.com/glacier-campground-accommodations-tent-cabin-rv-trailers-rooftop-tents/ ('A 10% Discount (RV/Trailer/Tent only, LAWN and CABINS excluded) is available for Military, Retired Military, Police Officers & Firefighters'), read 2026-10-22

note: Family-owned, heavily wooded 40-acre campground on US-2 a mile west of the West Glacier entrance to Glacier NP, surrounded by the Flathead National Forest, beside the BNSF railroad. Sunflower Cafe in the campground (reopening June 2027). Office open mid-May to about the beginning of October. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Campspot: confirmed 30-amp/water (no sewer), 32-ft max, Campspot booking, military discount. Added fees $68.25 (20-amp RV to 26 ft) to $88.25 (large 30-amp) for 2027, pull-throughs, 74 RV sites, flush toilets/laundry/dump/store/wifi (office only). The operator's page no longer posts prices (the $50-75 in the note is gone; Campspot's 2027 prices are higher). Not stated: showers (bathhouses not described as having them), a campground season (only office hours). Note trimmed of restated prices/rating.
